name: Bus
title: Nahor's son and Aram's father
summary: Bus was the second son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and his wife Milcah. He is mentioned in the genealogy in Genesis 22 as part of Abraham's extended family. Bus is also known as the ancestor of the Buzites, and it is possible that Elihu from the book of Job was of his lineage.

keyEvents.title: Bus mentioned in Nahor's family tree
keyEvents.description: After Abraham was informed that his brother Nahor had sons, Bus is mentioned as the second son of Nahor and Milcah.

keyEvents.title: Possible connection to Elihu in the book of Job
keyEvents.description: Elihu, son of Barakel, is described as a Buzite, which may indicate that he was a descendant of Bus and belonged to the people who descended from him.

keyEvents.title: Bus mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy
keyEvents.description: Bus is mentioned alongside other nations in Jeremiah's prophecy about God's judgment on the nations, suggesting that Bus's descendants became a recognizable people in the ancient Middle East.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's family grows
keyEvents.description: The news of Nahor's sons, including Bus, reached Abraham after he had passed the test with Isaac on Mount Moriah, showing that God's blessing also rested upon the extended family.
